sentences.text: Isteyak Ahmad vs State Of U.P. on 22 May, 2023

Author: Deepak Verma
Bench: Deepak Verma
High Court Of Judicature At Allahabad
?Neutral Citation No. - 2023:Ahc:112115
Court No. - 87
Case :- Criminal Misc. Bail Application No. - 20764 of 2023
Applicant :- Isteyak Ahmad

entities.text: High Court Of Judicature At Allahabad
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text:
Opposite Party :- State of U.P.
Counsel for Applicant :- Raghvendra Prakash,Pranjal Chaudhari,Siddharth Srivastava
Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.
Hon'ble Deepak Verma,J.
1.
Heard learned counsel for the applicant and learned A.G.A. for the State and perused the record.

2. The instant bail application has been filed on behalf of the applicant with a prayer to release him on bail in Case Crime No. 48 of 2023, under Sections 120-B, 419, 420, 467, 468 and 471 I.P.C.,
Police Station- Gambhirpur, District- Azamgarh, during pendency of the trial.
3. Learned counsel for the applicant submitted that the applicant has come from Malaysia on visa and has falsely been implicated in the present case.
No specific role has been assigned to the applicant.
There is no evidence against the applicant to connect him in the present case.

Further submission is that co-accused Mohd. Asahad, Ansar Ahmad and Abul Khair have been granted bail by Co-ordinate Bench of this Court vide order dated 13.04.2023, 13.04.2023 and 05.05.2023 passed Isteyak Ahmad vs State Of U.P. on 22 May, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/150598026/
1 in Crl. Misc. Bail Application No. 15344 of 2023, 15302 of 2023 and 20160 of 2023 and the case of the applicant stands on identical footing, hence he is entitled to be enlarged on bail on the ground of parity.

entities.text: Isteyak Ahmad vs State Of U.P.
entities.label: PRECEDENT

entities.text: Crl. Misc. Bail Application No. 15344 of 2023, 15302 of 2023 and 20160 of 2023
entities.label: CASE_NUMBER

sentences.text: The applicant has no criminal history.
Moreover, there is no prospect of trial of the present case being concluded in near future.
The applicant is languishing in jail since 15.02.2023 and in case he is enlarged on bail he will not misuse the liberty of bail and co-operate in trial.
4. Learned A.G.A. has opposed the bail prayer of the applicant.

5. Considering the entire facts and circumstances of the case, submissions of learned counsel for the parties and keeping in view the nature of offence, evidence, complicity of accused and without expressing any opinion on the merits of the case and the law laid down by the Apex Court in Satendra Kumar Antil Vs. C.B.I. & Another, passed in S.L.P.(Crl.) No. 5191 of 2021, the Court is of the view that the applicant has made out a case for bail.

entities.text: Satendra Kumar Antil Vs. C.B.I. & Another
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: The bail application is allowed.

6. Let the applicant, Isteyak Ahmad, who is involved in the aforesaid case crime, be released on bail on his furnishing a personal bond and two sureties each in the like amount to the satisfaction of the court concerned subject to following conditions.
Further, before issuing the release order, the sureties be verified.
i. The applicant shall not tamper with the prosecution evidence by intimidating/ pressurizing the witnesses, during the investigation or trial.
ii. The applicant shall cooperate in the trial sincerely without seeking any adjournment.
iii. The applicant shall not indulge in any criminal activity or commission of any crime after being released on bail.
7. In case of breach of any of the above conditions, it shall be a ground for cancellation of bail.

Order Date :- 22.5.2023 Anjali  Isteyak Ahmad vs State Of U.P. on 22 May, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/150598026/
